text:
leah: Seeing a surge of SAML assertion failures for tenant `helios` after yesterday's cert rotation. Assertion consumer returns 400 and our SAML proxy reports decryption failures. Anyone on call?

omar: paste the minimal logs pls. Is this during handshake or post-assertion decrypt?

leah: logs (staging):
```
2025-11-02T21:14:03Z saml-proxy ERROR tenant=helios POST /sso/acs 400 {\"detail\":\"assertion decrypt failed\", \"code\":\"DECRYPT_ERR\"}
2025-11-02T21:14:03Z kms-client ERROR tenant=helios unwrap: unsupported algorithm: rsa-1024
```

devon: unsupported algorithm -> looks like a legacy key in our KMS. Did tenant rotate to a new SP cert but we still have old assertions encrypted with an older key?

omar: checking tenant metadata cache: our metadata cache TTL is 12h; the vendor pushed new metadata with ephemeral enc certs 6h ago. Some proxies hit stale metadata and attempted to decrypt with old envelope keys.

sec-bot: [audit] saml-decrypt-fail tenant=helios count=42 window=30m first_seen=2025-11-02T21:10:12Z

leah: interesting. I also noticed RBAC lookups started failing because NameID format changed (transient pairwise -> persistent). Role mapping relies on NameID for legacy tenants. if assertions are rejected we can't upstream groups.

devon: two related problems: 1) metadata cache staleness -> wrong cert selection -> KMS unwrap fails; 2) tenant still accepting SHA1-signed old assertions during a transition window -> vuln triage flag. We flagged RSA-1024 keys during last audit as disallowed, but the vendor still sends one for backward compat.

omar: immediate mitigation: reduce metadata cache TTL to 5m for tenants in transition, and enable a short-lived bypass to fetch fresh metadata on decrypt failure. also add a soft-fail path: if decrypt fails but signature verifies against the fresh metadata, accept assertion and log full raw assertion to audit for triage.

leah: be careful about logging raw assertions (PII). We need to redact attributes but capture enough to debug (headers, cert thumbprint, NameID, and a masked attribute list). Add an entry in the compliance tracker first.

sec-bot: [policy] raw-assertion-logging requires change-request CR-20251102-7 and retention 7d max.

devon: vuln triage note: create a follow-up to block RSA-1024 at the gateway and notify partners. Also schedule a KMS rewrap job to re-encrypt any lingering envelopes encrypted with legacy keys.

omar: i'll implement the metadata hot-fetch on decrypt-fail and temp TTL change. leah, can you coordinate the CR for raw-assertion logging and permission check?

leah: filing CR and a ticket to migrate RBAC mapping off NameID to persistent externalId/email where possible. For helios quick-fix: add fallback mapping by email so role assignment continues if NameID changes.

deploy-bot: [deploy] staging: metadata-ttl-reduce + decrypt-hotfetch rolled out to staging at 22:00 UTC.

sec-bot: [audit] saml-decrypt-fail reduced 80% in staging after patch.

devon: next steps: 1) run KMS scan to find envelopes using rsa-1024 and schedule rewrap; 2) prod rollout of TTL/hotfetch after compliance signoff for raw logs; 3) RBAC migration RFC; 4) vendor notification about disallowed algos.

leah: i'll draft the incident postmortem and include a timeline and remediation checklist. Thanks team.
